symbols.name: fatal_if_io_error
symbols.evidence: Tests the global DOS I/O error, restores video/timer/audio state, reports the error, and exits.

symbols.name: load_trekdat
symbols.evidence: Opens trekdat.lzs and allocates/decompresses its records into the eight-entry TREKDAT segment table.

symbols.name: sample_pit_seed
symbols.evidence: Mixes four reads from PIT channels 0 and 1 into a 16-bit seed.

symbols.name: game_main
symbols.evidence: Called by the Borland CRT entry after BSS/argv initialization.

symbols.name: play_sound_effect
symbols.evidence: Starts one of the indexed PC-speaker or sampled effects and records the current timer tick.

symbols.name: sound_effect_is_active
symbols.evidence: Tests the current PC-speaker note or the eight-tick sampled-effect window.

symbols.name: road_cell_at_position
symbols.evidence: Maps 32-bit road distance and horizontal position into the loaded seven-column road-cell stream.

symbols.name: test_finish_gate
symbols.evidence: Tests road shapes 1, 3, and 5 against the midpoint of the executable-resident lower/upper ship profiles for level completion.

symbols.name: initialize_level_input
symbols.evidence: Captures joystick centers for mode 1 or initializes the mouse for mode 2.

symbols.name: sample_level_input
symbols.evidence: Produces steering, throttle, and jump from keyboard, joystick, mouse, or demo.rec according to game mode.

symbols.name: select_ship_attitude
symbols.evidence: Maps vertical velocity and height to the renderer's level/up/down attitude index 0, 1, or 2.

symbols.name: road_column_from_horizontal
symbols.evidence: Maps the ship's 1/128 horizontal coordinate to a clamped road column 0 through 6.

symbols.name: road_surface_height
symbols.evidence: Returns the renderer surface height for a road cell, shape class, and finish-gate state.

symbols.name: render_gameplay_frame
symbols.evidence: Selects the car animation/attitude/lane frame, derives surface clearance and road phase, then calls draw_road_scene.

symbols.name: map_binary_display_sprite
symbols.evidence: Expands a dashboard sprite's 0/1/2 bytes into transparent and two caller-selected hardware colors in the shared picture scratch buffer.

symbols.name: render_dashboard_sprite
symbols.evidence: Reads the DAT sprite offset/width/height header, chooses VGA or EGA normal/alternate colors, maps its pixels, and submits the picture to the configured blitter.

symbols.name: render_embedded_binary_sprite
symbols.evidence: Maps an executable-resident 0/1/other bitmap to transparent and two selected colors, then draws it through the shared picture blitter.

symbols.name: draw_dashboard_number
symbols.evidence: Draws one to four right-aligned decimal digits from the executable-resident 4-by-5 bitmap table using the 1/10/100/1000 divisor table.

symbols.name: read_video_pixel
symbols.evidence: Reads one VGA byte or reconstructs one EGA planar pixel at the supplied screen coordinate.

symbols.name: write_video_pixel
symbols.evidence: Writes one VGA byte or programs the EGA set/reset mask for one pixel at the supplied screen coordinate.

symbols.name: fill_progress_column
symbols.evidence: Walks the dashboard's same-color vertical progress-track run at x=42+column from y=143 and recolors the run with palette index 0x60.

symbols.name: swap_rectangle_colors
symbols.evidence: Exchanges two selected palette indices over a dashboard warning rectangle through the per-pixel VGA/EGA accessors.

symbols.name: update_gameplay_dashboard
symbols.evidence: Updates delta sprites for speed, oxygen, and fuel; toggles the oxygen/fuel warning rectangles and alarm on a nine-tick phase; fills level progress; and switches the embedded jumpmaster bitmap.

symbols.name: cell_blocks_ship_profile
symbols.evidence: Applies the executable-resident 38-entry ship profile tables to road obstacle classes 1 through 5.

symbols.name: test_ship_collision
symbols.evidence: Tests ship-width road samples and vertical clearance against the decoded road-cell descriptors.

symbols.name: move_ship_with_collision
symbols.evidence: Subdivides requested movement into fifths, advances to the last collision-free point, then refines distance by /16 and horizontal/height motion by /5.

symbols.name: apply_road_cell_effect
symbols.evidence: Implements slow, refill, boost, and end/crash behavior for road-cell low-nibble kinds 2, 9, 10, and 12.

symbols.name: prediction_cell_is_open_or_terminal
symbols.evidence: Classifies the road-cell shape and kind fields used by the collision-motion predictor, accepting empty and kind-12 terminal cells.

symbols.name: predict_collision_motion
symbols.evidence: Simulates gravity, forward speed, throttle, lateral drift, and surface impulse until road height, then tests the prior and landing cells.

symbols.name: resolve_collision_motion
symbols.evidence: Tries the executable's exact six-step sequence of +/-10% lateral-velocity and forward-speed adjustments until predict_collision_motion accepts the trajectory.

symbols.name: gameplay_loop
symbols.evidence: Tick-synchronized input, fixed-point movement, collision, fuel/oxygen, render, and level-end loop called by run_level.

symbols.name: run_level
symbols.evidence: Initializes per-level state, enters gameplay_loop, shows completion/end text, and restores handlers.

symbols.name: initialize_road_renderer
symbols.evidence: Expands TREKDAT and selects VGA/EGA road primitive function pointers.

symbols.name: draw_road_scene
symbols.evidence: Dispatches decoded road cell types through the renderer table and presents the resulting frame.

symbols.name: road_draw_type_0
symbols.evidence: EXE draw-dispatch table entry 0.

symbols.name: road_draw_type_2
symbols.evidence: EXE draw-dispatch table entry 2.

symbols.name: road_draw_type_3
symbols.evidence: EXE draw-dispatch table entry 3.

symbols.name: road_draw_type_4
symbols.evidence: EXE draw-dispatch table entry 4.

symbols.name: road_draw_type_5
symbols.evidence: EXE draw-dispatch table entry 5.

symbols.name: road_draw_type_1
symbols.evidence: EXE draw-dispatch table entry 1.

symbols.name: road_primitive_0
symbols.evidence: Primitive renderer target recovered from draw handlers.

symbols.name: road_primitive_1
symbols.evidence: Primitive renderer target recovered from draw handlers.

symbols.name: road_primitive_2
symbols.evidence: Primitive renderer target recovered from draw handlers.

symbols.name: road_primitive_3
symbols.evidence: Primitive renderer target recovered from draw handlers.

symbols.name: road_primitive_4
symbols.evidence: Primitive renderer target recovered from draw handlers.

symbols.name: draw_vga_ship_and_shadow
symbols.evidence: Builds the 29-by-33 visibility mask, draws the 29-by-24 x-major car frame through it, then applies the selected VGA road-shadow mask.

symbols.name: build_ship_visibility_mask
symbols.evidence: Clears the first 956 bytes of SS:0E92 and clips 33 29-pixel rows against height, horizontal position, the DS:044A edge table, and surface clearance.

symbols.name: draw_ega_ship_shadow
symbols.evidence: Selects one of five DS:065E shadow masks from clearance, clips it through the EGA visibility/occupancy buffers, and increments eligible planar pixels.

symbols.name: draw_vga_ship_shadow
symbols.evidence: Selects one of five DS:065E shadow masks, clips it through the final nine rows of SS:0E92, and applies the exact VGA palette-index shadow transform.

symbols.name: prepare_ega_road_buffer
symbols.evidence: Indirect renderer setup target selected for the EGA path; programs planar VGA-compatible registers and copies the road viewport buffer.

symbols.name: prepare_vga_road_buffer
symbols.evidence: Indirect VGA renderer setup target that invokes road_render_frame with AX=0 before drawing the next road scene.

symbols.name: road_render_frame
symbols.evidence: Entry of recovered per-frame road setup/render range.

symbols.name: transfer_ega_road_delta
symbols.evidence: Indirect road_render_frame update target selected for the EGA path.

symbols.name: transfer_vga_road_delta
symbols.evidence: Indirect road_render_frame update target selected for the VGA path.

symbols.name: trekdat_normalize
symbols.evidence: Secondary normalization pass immediately preceding TREKDAT expansion.

symbols.name: trekdat_expand_records
symbols.evidence: Expands 0x410 shape rows for each of eight TREKDAT buffers.

symbols.name: install_timer_interrupts
symbols.evidence: Installs INT 08h/24h vectors and programs PIT channels.

symbols.name: timer_interrupt_handler
symbols.evidence: INT 08h vector target installed by 0x3ab0.

symbols.name: restore_timer_interrupts
symbols.evidence: Restores saved INT 08h vector and PIT state.

symbols.name: convert_picture_to_ega_dither
symbols.evidence: Rewrites decompressed indexed picture bytes through the CMAP two-byte dither table with alternating scanline parity for the EGA path.

symbols.name: allocation_stack_push_bytes
symbols.evidence: Allocates a DOS segment for a 32-bit byte count and pushes the segment on the game's allocation stack.

symbols.name: allocation_scope_push
symbols.evidence: Pushes segment value 1 as a sentinel on the game's allocation stack.

symbols.name: allocation_scope_pop
symbols.evidence: Pops and frees allocation-stack segments until it reaches the value-1 scope sentinel.

symbols.name: allocation_stack_pop_one
symbols.evidence: Pops the most recent segment from the game's allocation stack and releases it.

symbols.name: load_color_map
symbols.evidence: Consumes a CMAP tag, one-byte color count, three-byte VGA palette entries, and two-byte EGA dither mappings from the buffered resource stream.

symbols.name: load_allocated_color_map
symbols.evidence: Allocates and fills a caller-described color map from the same CMAP stream representation.

symbols.name: offset_nonzero_picture_pixels
symbols.evidence: Adds a caller-provided palette base to each nonzero byte in a decompressed picture, traversing far-memory segment boundaries.

symbols.name: load_compressed_picture
symbols.evidence: Consumes a PICT header, allocates width*height bytes, LZS-decompresses the pixels, then selects EGA dither conversion or VGA palette-base adjustment.

symbols.name: open_buffered_resource_stream
symbols.evidence: Opens a DOS file and initializes the executable's 4 KiB buffered byte/bit stream around its handle.

symbols.name: close_buffered_resource_stream
symbols.evidence: Closes the active buffered resource handle and routes DOS errors through fatal_if_io_error.

symbols.name: configure_picture_blitter
symbols.evidence: Stores the reference/source segment, destination segment, restore threshold, and direction flag, and patches the immediate transparency cutoff used by compose_picture_row.

symbols.name: compose_picture_row
symbols.evidence: Copies reference margins and composites a picture row: pixels below its self-modified cutoff are transparent, the interval below the restore threshold comes from the reference buffer, and the remainder is copied from the source.

symbols.name: draw_picture
symbols.evidence: Draws a segment/screen-offset/height/width picture descriptor row by row through the configured VGA/EGA blitter.

symbols.name: copy_picture_to_video
symbols.evidence: Copies a picture descriptor directly into VGA memory by scanline or through the EGA planar transfer helper.

symbols.name: drain_keyboard_and_latch_intro_abort
symbols.evidence: Drains every pending BIOS keyboard event and sets DS:54AC when the intro-abort latch at DS:AF42 is enabled.

symbols.name: interpolate_palette
symbols.evidence: Interpolates palette bytes with signed IDIV truncation, writes each intermediate DAC range, and waits on the 36 Hz tick until the requested duration.

symbols.name: play_intro_sequence
symbols.evidence: Loads intro.lzs, the 100-group ANIM archive, intro.snd, and music track 0, then drives the timed opening picture and sound sequence.

symbols.name: fade_palette
symbols.evidence: Captures the selected VGA palette range and calls interpolate_palette in either the to-black or from-black direction for the requested duration.

symbols.name: show_settings_menu
symbols.evidence: Loads setmenu.lzs and implements the five-item input/sound grid, immediate setting application, music enable/disable behavior, and config save.

symbols.name: show_help_page
symbols.evidence: Loads and displays one sequential helpmenu.lzs page, waits for a key, and reports whether Escape dismissed it.

symbols.name: show_help_pages
symbols.evidence: Displays the first help page and displays the second unless Escape dismissed the first.

symbols.name: show_main_menu
symbols.evidence: Loads mainmenu.lzs/gomenu.lzs and dispatches Start, Settings, or Help from the three-item keyboard menu.

symbols.name: draw_level_menu_selector
symbols.evidence: Restores or highlights one of the 30 gomenu.lzs level cells using the executable's two-column, five-group, three-row layout.

symbols.name: show_level_selection
symbols.evidence: Draws completion markers and implements the exact 30-level selection keyboard loop, returning Start or Back.

symbols.name: load_world
symbols.evidence: Loads the selected worldN.lzs palette/background records used by the level renderer and dashboard.

symbols.name: load_display_table
symbols.evidence: Reads a selected word table from a dashboard DAT file into a caller-supplied buffer.

symbols.name: load_dashboard_tables_and_demo
symbols.evidence: Loads oxy_disp.dat, ful_disp.dat, speed.dat, and demo.rec.

symbols.name: load_graphics_archives
symbols.evidence: Loads cars.lzs and the dashboard/title graphics archives used after startup.

symbols.name: load_music_track
symbols.evidence: Selects a track in muzax.lzs, decompresses it, and rebuilds the OPL playback state.

symbols.name: load_road
symbols.evidence: Reads a roads.lzs index entry, loads gravity/fuel/oxygen and palette data, then decompresses the seven-column road stream.

symbols.name: update_config_checksum
symbols.evidence: Computes and stores the SKYROADS.CFG checksum over its 32 setting/completion words.

symbols.name: load_config
symbols.evidence: Loads SKYROADS.CFG, validates its checksum, and zeroes the settings block on error.

symbols.name: save_config
symbols.evidence: Updates the checksum and writes the 0x42-byte settings/completion block to SKYROADS.CFG.

symbols.name: opl_write_register
symbols.evidence: Writes an address/value pair to the OPL ports with the required delay reads.

symbols.name: opl_silence
symbols.evidence: Clears OPL channel/key-on state through opl_write_register.

symbols.name: initialize_opl
symbols.evidence: Initializes OPL registers and instrument playback state.

symbols.name: opl_event_set_delay
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 0: stores the event high byte in the timer delay counter.

symbols.name: opl_event_set_instrument
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 1: keys off the channel and programs its two operator blocks and channel register from a 16-byte instrument.

symbols.name: opl_event_note_on
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 2: derives octave/F-number for melodic channels and sets the corresponding rhythm bit for percussion channels.

symbols.name: opl_event_note_off
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 3: clears melodic key-on or the channel's rhythm bit in register BDh.

symbols.name: opl_write_scaled_level
symbols.evidence: Preserves an operator's key-scale bits, adds the selected attenuation with saturation at 3Fh, and writes its level register.

symbols.name: opl_event_set_volume
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 4: applies the 31-entry attenuation table to the carrier and, for additive instruments, the modulator.

symbols.name: opl_event_rewind_loop
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 5: restores the event cursor from the saved loop cursor.

symbols.name: opl_event_mark_loop
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 6: saves the already-advanced event cursor as the loop target.

symbols.name: opl_event_set_signal
symbols.evidence: OPL event opcode 7: stores the event high byte in the playback signal byte.

symbols.name: audio_timer_tick
symbols.evidence: Called directly by the timer ISR before PC-speaker scheduling.

symbols.name: start_opl_event_stream
symbols.evidence: Installs the event cursor, loop cursor, instrument base, and clears the playback signal for a decompressed music track.

symbols.name: detect_sound_blaster
symbols.evidence: Probes candidate DSP base ports and records the detected Sound Blaster port.

symbols.name: program_sound_blaster_dma
symbols.evidence: Masks the selected 8-bit DMA channel, programs its page/address/count registers from a far sample pointer, then unmasks DMA.

symbols.name: start_sound_blaster_sample
symbols.evidence: Programs 8-bit DMA and sends DSP commands 40h (time constant) and 14h (single-cycle 8-bit playback) with the payload count.

symbols.name: stop_sound_blaster_sample
symbols.evidence: Sends DSP command D0h and masks the configured DMA channel when Sound Blaster playback is available.

symbols.name: dos_close
symbols.evidence: DOS INT 21h/3Eh close wrapper.

symbols.name: dos_open_read
symbols.evidence: DOS INT 21h/3D00h open-for-read wrapper with centralized error capture.

symbols.name: dos_puts
symbols.evidence: Writes a NUL-terminated near string through dos_putchar.

symbols.name: dos_seek
symbols.evidence: DOS INT 21h/42h seek wrapper returning DX:AX.

symbols.name: dos_read_near_exact
symbols.evidence: DOS INT 21h/3Fh near-buffer read wrapper that flags short reads.

symbols.name: dos_read_far_exact
symbols.evidence: Far-buffer adapter around dos_read_near_exact.

symbols.name: dos_putchar
symbols.evidence: DOS INT 21h/02h output wrapper with LF-to-CRLF translation.

symbols.name: bios_set_video_mode
symbols.evidence: BIOS INT 10h/AH=00h video-mode wrapper.

symbols.name: detect_ega
symbols.evidence: BIOS INT 10h/AH=12h, BL=10h EGA information probe.

symbols.name: detect_vga
symbols.evidence: BIOS INT 10h/AX=1A00h display-combination probe accepting VGA codes 7 and 8.

symbols.name: dos_free_segment
symbols.evidence: DOS INT 21h/49h segment-release wrapper.

symbols.name: borland_crt_entry
symbols.evidence: MZ CS:IP entry point.

symbols.name: dos_alloc_bytes
symbols.evidence: Rounds a 32-bit byte count to paragraphs and allocates it through DOS INT 21h/48h.

symbols.name: stream_read_u16_le
symbols.evidence: Reads two bytes through the buffered stream and combines them little-endian.

symbols.name: lzs_decompress
symbols.evidence: Decodes the game's bit-packed literal/back-reference stream into a far output buffer.
